# Your environment is evidence about your environment

## The heuristic

**Failing to see the symptom in your own environment is data about your environment.**


_Why:_ Internal environments are configured by people who understand the product, hold current versions, clean data and generous permissions — precisely the conditions customers do not satisfy. The difference between the two setups is a hypothesis, not a reassurance.
